title: Harden audit retry convergence for multi-evidence turns
description:
Problem

The retry/repair loop is currently whack-a-mole. A rejected attempt may identify one missing requirement, the retry fixes it, then a second attempt is rejected for a different missing requirement. This produced player-visible hard failures in ordinary dialogue.

Observed pattern:
- Attempt 1 needs record_world_fact for missing scouts and/or movement near the tower.
- Attempt 2 records the facts but is rejected for missing world_query of Warden Sela or another module-canon support.
- Player sees a hard failure even though the repair path is obvious.

Goal

Improve retry convergence for turns that need multiple kinds of support: world_query, record_world_fact, scene-local evidence, and audit-safe wording.

Acceptance criteria

- Retry prompt carries cumulative missing requirements from earlier rejected attempts.
- The system distinguishes:
  - missing world_query
  - missing record_world_fact
  - rumor used as confirmed fact
  - failed tool call incorrectly relied upon
  - unsupported exact detail
  - wrong tool chosen for a consequential fact
- If a later retry fixes earlier requirements but exposes a new missing-tool/evidence class, the system can make one additional repair attempt within a bounded limit.
- Rejected mutating calls remain rolled back; no rejected record_world_fact, set_plot_flag, inventory, clock, HP, or condition changes leak into accepted state.
- Repair guidance should encourage:
  - query module canon first when resolving existing NPCs/locations/lore
  - record consequential new lore before asserting it
  - use scene-local evidence for immediate continuity where available
  - avoid unsupported exact numbers unless sourced or recorded
- Regression covers a turn requiring both:
  - world_query for Warden Sela
  - record_world_fact for missing scouts / new consequential report
- Regression covers a failed first retry followed by a successful second retry without player-visible hard failure.
- Debug logs show the cumulative repair requirements clearly.
close_reason: Added cumulative audit repair requirements and bounded extra repair attempt when a retry exposes a new missing evidence class.
